answer: Each identity may endorse only 3 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 750 aliases need 750 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The lotus of the decay is the wall, the marble of the random walk is the audit, and the reef of the distance is public every epoch.
